facts.fact: Africa Insight reports that on 6 April 2026 the University of Djibouti (CRMN and CEALT) and Jamhuuriya University launched the Somali-Language AI & Innovation Lab (SAIL) and a Somali fake-news detection research project using NLP and deep learning, with machine translation and voice assistants as long-term aims.

systems.owner: University of Djibouti and Jamhuuriya University
